frameworks.name: Metasploit Framework
frameworks.note: NetCast3r has scoped HTTP, upload, and oracle primitives but no session/payload layer.

frameworks.name: Sliver
frameworks.note: No C2 or implant lifecycle; adding one requires explicit authorization and a lab-only design.

frameworks.name: Cobalt Strike
frameworks.note: Commercial C2; not integrated. Do not emulate without a signed engagement.

frameworks.name: PowerShell Empire
frameworks.note: No agent runtime. PowerShell tradecraft is a lab-only future module.

frameworks.name: BloodHound
frameworks.capabilities: AD graph, attack paths, ACL analysis
frameworks.note: No AD collector or graph ingestion. NetCast3r can store the resulting paths as evidence.

frameworks.name: Impacket
frameworks.capabilities: SMB, MSRPC, Kerberos, LDAP protocol toolkit
frameworks.note: No SMB/Kerberos client. A read-only AD probe is on the roadmap.

frameworks.name: NetExec
frameworks.capabilities: SMB/WinRM/LDAP/MSSQL command execution and auth checks
frameworks.note: NetCast3r can scope and audit a single credential check; it does not spray or execute commands.

frameworks.name: Responder
frameworks.note: Poisoning is not appropriate for a bug-bounty framework; keep it lab-only.

frameworks.name: Certipy
frameworks.capabilities: AD CS enumeration and certificate abuse
frameworks.note: No AD CS collector. Certificate templates are a high-value future chain.

frameworks.name: Rubeus
frameworks.note: No Kerberos ticket operations.

frameworks.name: Mimikatz
frameworks.note: Credential dumping is host-level and requires an isolated lab.

frameworks.name: Chisel
frameworks.note: No tunnel manager. Pivoting needs an explicit engagement and network map.

frameworks.name: Ligolo-ng
frameworks.note: No TUN integration.

frameworks.name: Nmap
frameworks.note: NetCast3r's host_probe is explicit-port and bounded; it is not a replacement for a full scan.

frameworks.name: Burp Suite
frameworks.note: NetCast3r drives its own HTTP/browser and can call a configured Burp MCP server.

frameworks.name: Caido
frameworks.note: No direct adapter; HTTP/browser tools cover the same manual workflow.

frameworks.name: Ghidra
frameworks.note: reveng_analyze triages imports, strings, and hardening; it does not replace a decompiler.

frameworks.name: Frida
frameworks.note: Mobile analysis is static; Frida templates are documented but not executed by the server.

frameworks.name: Prowler
frameworks.note: No cloud posture scanner; cloud work is scoped manual/API-first.

frameworks.name: Pacu
frameworks.note: No AWS exploitation modules.

frameworks.name: ROADtools
frameworks.note: No Entra graph collector.

frameworks.name: Hashcat
frameworks.note: The toolbook documents it; cracking is not run by the server.

frameworks.name: Semgrep
frameworks.note: reveng_analyze performs local source analysis; semgrep can be wired as a parser later.
